verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only offers generic marketing language about Svelte's compiler producing efficient DOM updates, but never mentions embedding a compiled component into an existing server-rendered HTML page, progressive enhancement, or a mount/hydrate API for incremental adoption. Missing for 10: any documentation or example of injecting a Svelte component into non-Svelte HTML, hydration/mount API details, or community reports of successful incremental adoption on legacy pages.
